attempts.summary: Inventory web tier completed and verified. node2/node3 run nginx 1.26.3 on port 8080; node1 runs HAProxy 3.0.5 on port 80 with round-robin health-checked backends. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 were preserved. SELinux remains enforcing, firewalld remains active, and all three nodes recovered after sequential restarts.
